plan.summary: This 4-week opening block builds a simple off-camp base for boxing with one focused weekly session: explosive work first, then foundational strength, then practical accessories and short conditioning. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so later percentage work is grounded. The main program starts in Week 2 and keeps volume conservative so it supports boxing practice rather than competing with it.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body force, basic explosive ability, trunk strength, and enough conditioning to support boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly heavier work while keeping the weekly session crisp and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster power and cleaner speed expression while maintaining enough strength to hold onto force gains.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and safely. Reset between reps and chase sharp takeoffs, not fatigue.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no sturdy box is available. Stick each landing and reset between reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Broad Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if space is available and landing mechanics stay clean.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few gradual sets, then perform one hard top set of 3-5 clean reps to establish your baseline for future loading. Stop before form breaks and keep your torso tall.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your baseline for future percentage work.
